name: Organic / Living Light
displayName: 有机光感 · 叶隙之间
description: 苔绿留白、透光叶片与缓慢光斑；用呼吸式尺度和光照相位表现材料、环境和感受。

canvas.adaptation: Reference composition; reflow freely for 9:16 or 1:1. Not an automatic aspect converter.

audio.note: Silent concept preview. Narration, character, voice, language and speaking rate remain user-controlled.

dependencies.fonts: Operating-system Arial/Georgia/monospace; none bundled or fetched. Font metrics can vary across systems.

variants.name: 透光材质
variants.recipe: Replace the leaf with authorized material imagery and keep one slowly moving light wash. Disable blend effects when they reduce contrast.

variants.name: 等高线静物
variants.recipe: Promote contour-stone.svg to the hero, use a muted canvas and draw its concentric paths sequentially for a tactile explanation.

usage.remix: Keep a large quiet field for the message. Layer translucent shapes and let a slow light pass reveal the material. Reuse the stone for tactile product or wellness stories without making health claims.
usage.avoid: Do not claim this abstract leaf is a verified botanical species. Soft motion still needs sufficient text contrast and readable dwell time.
usage.motion: 0–1.9s: text and material emerge; 2.2–3.4s: palette labels appear. Light and leaf motion remain slow and non-flashing.
usage.portrait: Place the leaf above or beside a shorter title. Keep translucent layers behind, rather than crossing, body text; reserve a quiet lower area for captions.
usage.captions: Reserve an uncluttered caption band. Recompose labels rather than obscuring subtitles. Preview footer labels are not subtitles.
